description: Paso 1 descarte matrix (WP-26). Spec for the C# DescarteEvaluator (PR-8, Tims.UnitTests/Intake/DescarteFixtureTests); its shape is checked by vitest in PR-8. Built on the register defaults: an uploaded but unreviewed document counts as cumple with verified=false (D-26-G). Rules: the latest non-superseded human decision wins (verified=true, source=human, never subsanable). Otherwise derived per kind: document = accepted (verified) > received > rejected (no_cumple, subsanable while the window is open) > none (no_cumple, missingDocument, subsanable while open), superseded files ignored; min_academic_degree and min_relevant_years compare against minValue (intake years, else the candidate profile; absent = revision; never subsanable); college_membership needs college and licence; declaration needs declaredAt with a known text version (verified); manual = revision. Window: until_deadline = now < deadline (null deadline = open while published), days_after_request = now < requestedAt + days, closed = never. Bucket: any knockout no_cumple -> incompleto when every failing knockout is subsanable, else no_cumple; otherwise any revision -> revision; otherwise cumple. Non-knockout requirements only affect the bucket through revision and are scored as desirableMet/desirableTotal. Synthetic data only.
